message:
🚀 Flex GUI Pro — Version 7.2.0 Maintenance & UI Update
This release brings a redesigned SS To AE workspace, restored multi-window panel ejection, 2D text animation structural fixes, and a boot guard system for legacy AE environments.

♦️ SS To AE — UI Redesign (v1.7.1)
* Visual Layout Overhaul: Rebuilt the interface architecture using MD3 card elements, custom sliders/selects, type-color indicator dots, and inline SVG icons.
* Theme-Aware System Styling: Powered by plain CSS using native system fonts, allowing workspace accents to dynamically follow your primary theme picker.

♦️ Panel Ejection & Diagnostics
* Restored Panel Eject Button: Restored local pop-out ejection support, allowing users to spawn up to 5 independent utility panel windows across workspace ports.

♦️ Core Bug Fixes & Text Engine Patches
* 2D Text Animation Preservation: Resolved an issue where text animations forced layers to 3D. The engine now snapshots your 3D status prior to executing host animators, preserving intentional 3D layers while preventing unwanted automatic 3D conversion.
* Mask Path Easing Calibration: Enforced speed values to zero for SHAPE properties inside Flow & Easing modules.
* Environment Python Command Resolver: Fixed BG Remover exit 9009 execution errors by properly declaring internal environment search commands.
* Graph Editor Speed Calibration (v3.6.0): Restored active speed graph calculations and stabilized adaptive axis displays during drag operations.

♦️ Legacy Environment Boot Guard
* AE 2022 Boot Guard Diagnostic: Implemented a head-loading boot guard to buffer initialization errors and render a readable recovery diagnostic panel featuring extension IDs, CEP/AE versions, and error logs if startup fails.
